meta.name: skills-finder
meta.description: Find Agent Skills on skills.sh and adopt only the ones that pass a security audit. Use when the user wants to discover, search for, evaluate, or install a third-party skill ("find a skill for X", "is this skill safe to install", "search skills.sh", "what skill should I use for Y"). Always runs the skills.sh security audit before recommending or installing anything, and refuses to adopt skills that fail the audit.

copy.tagline: 搜索并安全安装第三方技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在技能市场找技能并确保安全。
